name: Voxel Octree Terrain Generation and Meshing
definition: A voxel renderer using an octree structure to manage terrain chunks. It generates height maps, populates voxel grids based on height, and generates triangle meshes for visible chunks using a multi-threaded task system.
summary: Voxel Octree Terrain Generation and Meshing creates sparse voxel terrain by recursively subdividing an octree based on surface intersection tests to efficiently manage memory.
